housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 2,384.38 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Chicago city centre. A Chicago-specific deposit norm could not be grounded reliably; Zillow is the selected main rental portal based on its active Chicago apartment listings.

banking.summary: Chase says non-residents may need official government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN if the bank requires one.
required_docs: Proof of U.S. address showing name and address
SSN or ITIN if required by the bank

schools.summary: Chicago's international-school directory lists British, IB, International, German, Montessori, French, and American curricula among 12 English-teaching schools.

legal_admin.summary: For noncitizens covered by the federal rule, USCIS requires address changes to be reported within 10 days of moving, preferably through a USCIS online account or by paper Form AR-11; the page lists exceptions for A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report each change of address to USCIS within 10 days through the USCIS online account or paper Form AR-11, if subject to the rule.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign individual eligible for an SSN applies with SSA on Form SS-5; a person who cannot obtain an SSN applies to the IRS for an ITIN on Form W-7 with identity and foreign-status evidence, generally attaching a federal tax return unless an exception applies.

transport.summary: Chicago Transit Authority (CTA) buses and trains use the Ventra fare system; the regular 30-Day CTA/Pace Pass costs USD 75.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A new Illinois resident may use a valid home-state or foreign licence for 90 days; to obtain an Illinois licence, visit a Secretary of State facility, surrender the prior licence, and pass vision and written tests plus a possible road test. Illinois does not recognize an international driving licence. https://www.ilsos.gov/services/newresidents/newresidentshowdoi.html
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible for Illinois Medicaid, use the state's ABE portal to check eligibility and submit an application for health-care benefits. https://abe.illinois.gov/access/
